newsitem.title: USA: Hurricane Hortense threatens Puerto Rico.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane Hortense threatens Puerto Rico.

text.p: A hurricane warning was in effect for Puerto Rico and a tropical storm warning was in effect for the U.S. and British Virgin Islands Monday as Hurricane Hortense headed through the Caribbean.
At 1100 EDT/1500 GMT, the government of Dominican Republic issued a hurricane watch for its south coast from Cabo Engano to the Haitian border.

At that time, Hortense's center was near latitude 16.4 north and longitude 65.3 west, or about 135 miles (220 km) southeast of Ponce, Puerto Rico, and moving west near 6 mph (9 mph). A west to west-northwest mortion was expected for the next 24 hours, National Hurricane Center said.
"The forecast track brings hurricane-force winds dangerously close to portions of Puerto Rico," the hurricane center said.
Maximum sustained winds were near 80 mph (130 kmh) and some strengthening was likely during the next 24 hours. Hortense was a weak Category 1 hurricane.
Hurricane-force winds extended outward up to 60 miles (95 km) from the center and tropical storm force winds extended outward up to 175 miles (280 km).

Forecasters also warned of up to 12 inches (30 cm) of rain along Hortense's path. Such rains could produce flash floods and mudslides in mountainous terrain, while strong on-shore winds could produce storm surge flooding along Puerto Rico's south coast.
